description: This file contains the definition of the class `nusoap_xmlschema`, which is responsible for parsing, representing, and generating XML Schema documents within the NuSOAP PHP library. It includes functionality for handling schema components such as types, elements, attributes, imports, and their serialization, along with methods for processing XML schema files and strings.

classes.name: nusoap_xmlschema
classes.description: Main class for parsing and representing XML Schema documents, providing methods for processing schema components, serialization, and type management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes schema and XML files, parses them if provided.

methods.name: parseFile
methods.description: Parses an XML schema or XML document from a file or URL, then calls `parseString`.

methods.name: parseString
methods.description: Parses an XML string, setting appropriate handlers based on the type (schema or xml).

methods.name: CreateTypeName
methods.description: Generates a type name for unnamed types based on schema hierarchy.

methods.name: schemaStartElement
methods.description: Handler invoked when the parser encounters a start element; processes schema components.

methods.name: schemaEndElement
methods.description: Handler invoked when the parser encounters an end element; manages state stack.

methods.name: schemaCharacterData
methods.description: Handles character data within schema elements during parsing.

methods.name: serializeSchema
methods.description: Serializes the internal schema representation back into XML Schema format.

methods.name: xdebug
methods.description: Adds debugging information to internal debug logs.

methods.name: getPHPType
methods.description: Returns the PHP type associated with a schema type, deprecated.

methods.name: getTypeDef
methods.description: Retrieves the definition of a specified type, returning an array of its schema details.

methods.name: serializeTypeDef
methods.description: Serializes a type definition into an XML string, deprecated.

methods.name: typeToForm
methods.description: Generates HTML form elements for input based on a schema type, deprecated.

methods.name: addComplexType
methods.description: Adds a new complex type definition to the schema.

methods.name: addSimpleType
methods.description: Adds a new simple type definition to the schema.

methods.name: addElement
methods.description: Adds an element with specified attributes to the schema.
